title: Survivor like in one month Claude pro subscription
author: drangoht
selftext:
Hello everyone,

I've been a developer for a few decades now, mainly working with C# these days.

I love games like Vampire Survivor and Everything Is a Crab.

So I decided to use Claude Code to create my own game in that style—without writing a single line of code—and see what I could do with my one-month Pro subscription.

Here's the link to the game: https://drangoht.itch.io/chimera-protocol

Sources here: https://github.com/drangoht/Chimera-Protocol 

I welcome all feedback; I'm interested in hearing what you think

comments.author: Blizzxx
comments.body: You've got a lot of the core down already, but the biggest weakness by far is your overall ui just looks pure AI. The classic bubble boxes for everything needs to be massively reshifted, as well as your upgrade boxes. Some of your animations for spells and stuff also will need to be massively upgraded, the floating pentagons look like AI.

replies.author: drangoht
replies.body:
Thanks for your great feedback !
I will take it in account

comments.author: Moist_Signal_5080
comments.body: One thing that jumps out immediately is the music pausing during upgrades. Really takes you out of the flow of it.

replies.author: Square_Reason_6490
replies.body: Very good observation I couldn’t figure out what was driving me crazy in the vid and you nailed it, I’m also not a big fan of the track sounds like the kind of stuff my mom would yell at me to turn the tv down when I played games in my room as a kid. Congrats for getting a game done and shipping tho OP! Hats always off to those that cross the finishline

replies.author: drangoht
replies.body: Yes, it's true that this is the part I haven't worked on as much; I just quickly used some royalty-free music—that will also be part of the polishing process. Thanks!

replies.author: drangoht
replies.body: Yes, good point—something was bothering me, but I was too caught up in it. I'll keep that in mind. Thank you so much for the feedback.
